synopsis: Algoryx AGX Dynamics is a machinery-physics engine covering terrain, tires, tracks, hydraulics and granular material; the booklet positions such tools as strong in terrain and hydraulics but thin in sensor and scenario tooling [f16204, f15965, f8283]. Independent validation evidence includes a 2024 wheel-loader digging model that required a tire-ground friction coefficient of 2.0 to match measurements, with remaining errors attributed to tire-pressure modeling and a flat-ground assumption, and a peer-reviewed 2025 wheel-loader digital-twin calibration including terrain parameters [f6090, f6091, f8292]. Unity and Unreal integration is supported, TERA demonstrates a Unity/AGX excavator simulator with ROS integration, and an April 2025 Unity example added reverse automatic braking with lidar; the latest release found in the comparison was AGXUnity 5.5.1, dated 20 January 2026 [f8703, f4129, f15967, f9112]. The proposed middle-cost stack couples AGX via FMI for terrain, hydraulics and machine variants, but FMI support was explicitly not verified, leaving that integration assumption unresolved [f9286, f9111]. Licensing is commercial, with yearly per-seat Basic, Custom and Premium subscriptions priced on request and separate runtime, OEM and academic licenses [f8575].
